verdicts.reason: Both break the stacked three-box headline. KIT is pulled out of its white box, so an empty white bar is left behind, and the background is a pasted-together strip with hard vertical seams. A is worse: KIT is small, sits across the seam and on the busy blue powder, and the TRAVEL/MAKEUP boxes are small and float with no clear link to it. B's TRAVEL/MAKEUP text is larger and readable, and KIT sits on plain grey. But B's boxes are jammed against the top and bottom edges, KIT reads as a stray fragment, and the reading order (TRAVEL, MAKEUP, KIT) is broken.
